name: codex-custom-subagents
description: Use OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages providers as configurable Codex Desktop subagents on macOS and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex tasks with custom subagents.
interface.longDescription: Configure custom providers, models, primary/fallback routing, and OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages protocols, then let Codex Desktop delegate repository tasks to those subagents on macOS and Windows.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-custom-subagents to delegate this task to the configured custom subagent.
Use $codex-custom-subagents to split this work into parallel subagent tasks.
